title: RBI intervention, dollar flows push Indian rupee to two-month peak
description: The Indian rupee surged to a two-month peak against the U.S. dollar, buoyed by decisive central bank interventions and dollars flowing in from foreign banks. Positive domestic growth indicators bolstered confidence in the rupee. However, rising global bond yields and increased crude oil prices acted as constraints, while the Reserve Bank of India's focus on its FX forward book gained prominence.

title: Global Market: European shares muted as bond yields surge on inflation concerns

title: Global Market: Eurozone manufacturing growth hits four-year high in August
description: Eurozone manufacturing activity expanded at its fastest pace in more than four years in August, with the PMI rising to 52.7 as new orders and factory output strengthened. Germany led the recovery, while France also expanded, although Italy and Spain remained under pressure. Improving confidence and easing input cost inflation offered further signs of a broader industrial recovery.

title: Apple’s 2,275% gain under Tim Cook is a tough act for John Ternus to follow
description: Apple CEO Tim Cook has handed over the reins to John Ternus after a 15-year tenure that transformed Apple into a $4.6 trillion company. The stock has surged 2,275% since Cook succeeded Steve Jobs in 2011, as he diversified Apple beyond the iPhone. Ternus now faces the daunting task of sustaining that growth and delivering further value to shareholders.

title: Global Market: UK 10-year gilt yields hit highest level since 2008 as oil prices stoke inflation fears
description: UK government bond yields surged on Tuesday, with the 10-year gilt yield hitting its highest level since 2008 as rising oil prices revived inflation concerns. The 10-year yield climbed to around 5.23%, while the two-year yield rose to 4.59%.

title: Global Market: AI could force central banks to rethink monetary policy
description: Artificial intelligence could fundamentally reshape financial markets and force central banks to rethink monetary policy communication and regulation, according to Princeton economist Markus Brunnermeier. He warned that AI-powered trading systems could anticipate policy decisions faster than humans, creating “asymmetric understanding” and potentially increasing market volatility and manipulation risks.

title: HDFC Bank’s bonds fall to record low after CEO’s shock exit

The bank’s shares have also underperformed the broader market, though analysts say its fundamental creditworthiness remains intact. HDFC Bank is reportedly seeking an executive search firm to accelerate succession.

title: TBZ shares zoom 20%, hit upper circuit after GRT Jewellers open offer

title: US Treasury selloff pushes India 10-year bond yield towards 7%
